purpose: Single intake and execution ledger for the 59 supplied knowledge candidates. This is non-deployable operational evidence, not scientific validation.
inventory_method: Direct exact-title fetches against main; recursive Git tree returned 2404 untruncated entries. Keyword code searches for the four authored subjects and Inforg returned no hits. The inventory is preliminary for remaining candidates; exact-title absence is not proof of absent related coverage.
scope_note: All 59 supplied candidates have independent article identities and maintained Simple and Technical surfaces. 48 new subjects authored; 11 existing subjects inspected and expanded in host and Technical while retaining their existing legacy depth convention. No candidate consolidated, redirected, or excluded. No merge or deployment authorized.
validation_note: Authored source files are staged on the named branch. All source claims and references require independent scientific editorial review; the source URLs field records cited materials, not a claim that every full text or link has been independently inspected. Final GitHub CI and repository inventory checks remain necessary. Live MediaWiki verification not performed.

secondary_outline_research.status: initial inventory; no secondary articles authorized
